finding: Vacuum extraction performed on preterm newborns was not independently associated with severe long-term neurological morbidity.
mod_finding: Vacuum extraction performed on preterm newborns was not independently associated with severe long-term neurological morbidity.
gest_age: Preterm (less than 37 completed weeks of gestation); median (range) was 36 (29 to 36) weeks for vacuum extractions, 36 (23 to 36) for spontaneous vaginal delivery, and 35 (29 to 36) for Cesarean delivery within second stage of labor
